fuelAmount.description: The amount of fuel to fill in gallons; this is the additional fuel to add to the tank. This is a float type value.

fuelLevel.description: The fuel level of the vehicle in gallons.

message.content: The rear tires are currently at 30 PSI, which is below the desired 32 PSI. The nearest tire service center is located at **456 Oakwood Avenue, Rivermist, 83214**. You may want to head there to get the tires inflated to the recommended pressure.
